title: Your First Tactic: The Pin
summary: Trap an enemy piece so it can't move without exposing something bigger.

steps.text: A PIN happens when a piece can't move without exposing a more valuable piece behind it — often the king! Here, the black knight on e6 is PINNED: if it moves off the diagonal, the bishop would capture the king. So the knight is stuck.
Because the knight can't move, it's a great target! Any piece that attacks it can capture it for free, since the knight has no safe way to escape.

steps.prompt: The knight is pinned and can't escape — swoop in with your queen and capture it!
steps.successText: Free knight! Pins are a great way to win material.
steps.retryText: The knight can't move — capture it with your queen.

steps.text: Look out for pins in your own games too — if one of YOUR pieces is pinned, be careful not to move it and expose your king!
You've learned two great tactics: forks and pins! Now let's put it all together and learn some classic ways to deliver checkmate.
